scenes.text: You probably think you would love absolute peace and quiet, but the crushing, heavy silence of this special laboratory room in Minnesota will actually drive you completely insane in under an hour.
When you step inside this heavily insulated concrete chamber, which absorbs over ninety-nine percent of all sound waves, the quiet becomes so intense that your body becomes the sound source.
Within minutes, you will clearly hear your own heartbeat echoing loudly inside your skull, the air rushing through your lungs, and even the wet, mechanical sound of your blinking eyes.

This terrifying sensory deprivation completely ruins your physical balance and quickly triggers hallucinations, which is why the record stay is only forty-five minutes; comment if you could survive this and follow for more.
